title: Kettle & Co: winter campaign check-in
attendees: Hannah Brooks <hannah@kettleandco.example>, Omar Siddiqui <omar@kettleandco.example>, Lucy Tran <lucy@kettleandco.example>
transcript:
Hannah: Two weeks into the winter gift-box campaign. Omar, numbers?
Omar: Meta prospecting is at £38 CPA, target was £25. Google Search brand and gift terms are at £14. Retargeting is fine.
Hannah: So Search is carrying it. Let's move £2,000 of the remaining Meta prospecting budget into Google Search gift terms. Omar, can you do that today?
Omar: Yes, today.
Hannah: On Meta, I don't think the static is working. Lucy, what do we have in video?
Lucy: Nothing finished. I could brief a 15-second unboxing video, vertical, for Reels and TikTok. If I brief the freelancer by Monday we'd have it by the 13th.
Hannah: Do it. Message: the gift box arrives ready to give, no wrapping.
Lucy: Got it.
Omar: One problem. The Meta pixel isn't firing on the new checkout page since the site update. Our conversion numbers on Meta might be under-reported.
Hannah: That changes things. Omar, get that fixed with the dev team before we judge Meta. Priority.
Omar: I'll raise it with dev today.
Hannah: And I'd like to test free shipping messaging versus 10% off on the landing page. Lucy, can you set up the A/B test once the video's live?
Lucy: Sure. I'd want at least two weeks of data.
Hannah: Fine. Last thing: email. We said a gift guide email for the 20th. Lucy, still on?
Lucy: Yes, draft by the 14th for your review.
